description: A standard Flashlight.Can be used to light your way in the darkness. Press the Use Item button to light the Flashlight for up to 8 seconds. "Most of the battery life was wastefully used by the previous owner."

A very portable Flashlight with a good grip.Its efficient technology produces a powerful light while consuming less power. Press the Use Item button to light the Flashlight for up to 8 seconds. Has an increased Aim accuracy of +20 %. Has a reduced Depletion rate of -11 %.

A sturdy but heavy Flashlight that packs a lot of power. Press the Use Item button to light the Flashlight for up to 12 seconds. Has an increased Beam brightness of +30 %. Has an increased Blindness duration of +15 %. Has a reduced Aim accuracy of -20 %.

The bow and shank of a key, vibrating with remnant power.The Broken Key's power cannot be triggered by itself.Various objects can be attached to its jump ring, which channels the Key's power into various effects. Press the Use Item button to trigger the Mind Channel ability for up to 10 seconds. Mind Channel reveals various Auras, depending on the Add-ons the Key is equipped with.

A bent and dull Key that once held great power.The Dull Key's power cannot be triggered by itself.Various objects can be attached to its jump ring, which channels the Key's power into various effects. Press the Use Item button to trigger the Mind Channel ability for up to 5 seconds. Mind Channel reveals various Auras, depending on the Add-ons the Key is equipped with. Press the Use Item button while standing over the closed Hatch to open it. This action will consume the Key and is only available if it is not depleted.

A tarnished and crooked Key, vibrating with ominous power.The Skeleton Key's power cannot be triggered by itself.Various objects can be attached to its jump ring, which channels the Key's power into various effects. Press the Use Item button to trigger the Mind Channel ability for up to 30 seconds. Mind Channel reveals various Auras, depending on the Add-ons the Key is equipped with. Press the Use Item button while standing over the closed Hatch to open it. This action will consume the Key and is only available if it is not depleted.

An old piece of parchment made out of a skin-like material that is rolled and sealed with an uncoloured leather string. Holding and channelling the Map unlocks great potential in your Aura-reading abilities, revealing the Auras of all tracked objects at the cost of slowly burning it. Automatically tracks 1 Generator at the start of the Trial. Tracks any other Generator when coming within 8 metres. Tracks Chests, Generators and Totems that were revealed by Detective's Hunch. The Map has 20 Charges.

An piece of parchment made out of oddly fresh skin with blood on its edge that has yet to dry, and that is rolled and sealed with multiple coloured ropes and cords. Holding and channelling the Rainbow Map unlocks great potential in your Aura-reading abilities, revealing the Auras of all tracked objects at the cost of slowly burning it. Automatically tracks 3 random objects at the start of the Trial. Tracks the following objects when coming within 8 metres: Exit Gate Switches Generators Hatch Hooks Tracks Chests, Generators and Totems that were revealed by Detective's Hunch. The Rainbow Map has 20 Charges. "It disheartens me. All this unspeakable knowledge and gruelling effort and yet nothing tangible, nothing usable to get out of this nightmare." — Vigo's Journal

A bloodstained piece of parchment, hastily rolled and burning with a strange power. Holding and channelling the Bloodsense Map unlocks great potential in your Aura-reading abilities, revealing the Auras of all tracked objects at the cost of slowly burning it. Automatically tracks 3 random objects at the start of the Trial. Tracks the following objects when coming within 8 metres: Exit Gate Switches Generators Hatch Hooks Tracks Chests, Generators and Totems that were revealed by Detective's Hunch. Grants the ability to reveal the Auras of injured Survivors exclusively to yourself.. Causes Pools of Blood to spawn beneath you while being used. The Bloodsense Map has 20 Charges.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 6.7.0A rudimentary First Aid Kit which can save lives in emergencies, even if it's lacking some of its supplies.Can be used to heal other Survivors: Increased Altruistic Healing speed of +35 %. Unlocks the Self-Heal action: Reduced Personal Healing speed of -33 %. Reduced Item efficiency of -33 %. The Camping Aid Kit has a Capacity of 24 Charges. "Barely has enough material for a decent patch-up."

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 6.7.0A standard First Aid Kit with all the necessary equipment for treating common to more serious injuries.Can be used to heal other Survivors: Increased Altruistic Healing speed of +40 %. Unlocks the Self-Heal action: Reduced Personal Healing speed of -33 %. Reduced Item efficiency of -33 %. The First Aid Kit has a Capacity of 24 Charges.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 6.7.0A sturdy and well organised Med-Kit equipped with top condition emergency supplies.Can be used to heal other Survivors: Increased Altruistic Healing speed of +45 %. Unlocks the Self-Heal action: Reduced Personal Healing speed of -33 %. Reduced Item efficiency of -33 %. The Emergency Med-Kit has a Capacity of 24 Charges. "There is a cure for almost everything...but not for this."

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 6.7.0A large metal box containing medical supplies aimed at emergency rescues in hard to reach, often isolated locations.Can be used to heal other Survivors: Increased Altruistic Healing speed of +50 %. Unlocks the Self-Heal action: Reduced Personal Healing speed of -33 %. Reduced Item efficiency of -33 %. The Ranger Med-Kit has a Capacity of 24 Charges. "A small engraved label can be found glued to the back panel: VK.ID-3994723."

A metal box containing out of condition tools that could break at any moment.Even without training, can be used to repair or break various mechanical components. 16 Charges. Increases the Repair speed by +50 %. Reduces the Success zone of Good Skill Checks by -10 %. Unlocks the Sabotage action. "You call these tools? ... Really?"

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 8.0.0Metal box containing a set of basic tools.Even without training, can be used to repair or break various mechanical components. 20 Charges. Increases the Repair speed by +50 %. Unlocks the Sabotage action. Increases the Sabotage speed by +15 %. "It is unclear as to where these tools come from. Were they brought in by one of us or did they belong to one of the monsters?"

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 8.0.0A large metal box containing basic tool and extra mechanical parts.Even without training, can be used to repair or break various mechanical components. 32 Charges. Increases the Repair speed by +50 %. Unlocks the Sabotage action. Increases the Sabotage speed by +50 %.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 8.0.0A metal box with specialised mechanics tools.Even without training, can be used to repair or break various mechanical components. 16 Charges. Increases the Repair speed by +75 %. Unlocks the Sabotage action. Increases the Sabotage speed by +25 %.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 8.0.0A metal box containing mainly saws and vice grips of varying sizes but also other tools.Even though the content of this Toolbox is clearly aimed at destructive deeds, it can be used to repair various mechanical components as well. 18 Charges. Increases the Repair speed by +10 %. Unlocks the Sabotage action. Increases the Sabotage speed by +100 %. "Most of the tools are identified as 'owned by Alex'."

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 8.0.0A metal box with highly specialised tools meant for engineering.Most of the tools can be used by neophytes to make quick repairs or break various mechanical components. 16 Charges. Increases the Repair speed by +100 %. Unlocks the Sabotage action. Increases the Sabotage speed by +10 %. "I've created tools beyond compare and stood paralysed as they were stolen from me. These are but a poor replica, spat out by The Fog." — Vigo's Journal

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 8.0.0A Toolbox packed to the brim with fireworks, it is prepared to celebrate all your life's successes... and failures. 32 Charges. Increases the Repair speed by +50 %. Unlocks the Sabotage action. Increases the Sabotage speed by +50 %. Succeeding a Great Skill Check detonates a small cluster of firecrackers. Missing a Skill Check detonates fireworks. The Festive Toolbox is only available during Spring Events.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 8.2.0Limited Item In the darkest of castles, any light is a precious commodity. All Survivors start the Trial with a Candelabra held in hand. Additional Candelabras may be found in Chests located in the environment. The Auras of all Candelabras placed in the environment are revealed to all Survivors in white at all times. Pushes back the Fog as a passive effect when held. Press and hold the Use Item button while holding the Candelabra to benefit from the following effects: 90 Charges. The Aura of the nearest incomplete Generator is revealed to you. The Survivor Activity HUD is displayed to you, but without any visible Progression. Place the Candelabra on top of a Generator to benefit from the following effects: The Aura of that Generator is revealed to all Survivors within 32 metres. Completing that Generator causes it to suppress the Killer's ability to read the Auras of all remaining incomplete Generators for 15 seconds or until the Candelabra is removed from it by any means. Can be destroyed by the Killer when placed on Generators. The Candelabra is only available for use in the Lights Out - Castlevania Modifier Event. Limited Items are consumed on use.They cannot be brought back to the Campfire after a Trial and are removed by The Entity upon exiting the Trial.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 8.1.0Limited Item An electromagnetic pulse device that is printed by Supply Cases when facing The Singularity.The Auras of Supply Cases are visible when within 28 metres: Takes 100 Charges to be printed. Passive printing charges at a rate of +1 c/s, but is limited to 97 Charges, requiring the final 3 Charges to be actively printed by a Survivor. Active printing charges at a rate of +4 c/s while a Survivor interacts with the Supply Case. Takes 2.5 seconds to charge. Incurs a -10 % Hindered Status Effect while charging and holding. Has an Area of Effect of 10 metres. Removes Temporal Slipstream from anyone within its Area of Effect upon detonation. The Auras of other Slipstreamed Survivors are revealed to you in yellow when within the Area of Effect. Disables all Biopods within the Area of Effect for 45 seconds upon detonation and grants immunity to Temporal Slipstream for 1 second. Limited Items are consumed on use.They cannot be brought back to the Campfire after a Trial and are removed by The Entity upon exiting the Trial.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 8.0.0Limited Item Press the Use Item button to attune yourself with Eye of Vecna. When healthy, you are granted a special ability: Removes 1 Health State on use. Causes you to suffer from the Broken Status Effect for 30 seconds. Reveals the Aura of the nearest Locker in yellow. Rush exit that Locker to activate Eye of Vecna for 12 seconds: Suppresses your Aura. Grants you full invisibility. Grants +25 % Haste. Can be found in Treasure Chests located in the environment. Triggers Killer Instinct for 3 seconds after use. Magic Limited Items are depleted on use but kept on your person.They cannot be brought back to the Campfire after a Trial and are removed by The Entity upon exiting the Trial.

Limited Item A medication that helps reverse the effects of an Uroboros infection. Press the Use Item button to cure yourself or another Survivor from the Uroboros Infection. Can be found in Supply Cases located in the environment. The First Aid Spray has 2 Uses. Limited Items are consumed on use.They cannot be brought back to the Campfire after a Trial and are removed by The Entity upon exiting the Trial.

Craftable Limited Item Craftable when using Flashbang.Can be used as a distraction or blinding device. Press the Use Item button to detonate the Flash Grenade. Detonates with a loud bang and flashing lights, temporarily blinding and deafening any nearby Players. Triggers a Loud Noise Notification. Limited Items are consumed on use.They cannot be brought back to the Campfire after a Trial and are removed by The Entity upon exiting the Trial.

Limited Item A fragile pocket mirror pulled from the first White Glyph.Its surface is broken. Must be carried to the Basement without performing any of the following interactions: Rushed Actions of any kind. Falling from height. Dropping the Item. Shatters when attempting to escape the Trial with it. Limited Items are consumed on use.They cannot be brought back to the Campfire after a Trial and are removed by The Entity upon exiting the Trial.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 8.0.0Limited Item Press the Use Item button to attune yourself with Hand of Vecna. When healthy, you are granted a special ability: Removes 1 Health State on use. Causes you to suffer from the Broken Status Effect for 30 seconds. Reveals the Aura of the nearest Locker in yellow. Rush enter that Locker to activate Hand of Vecna: Teleports you to another Locker that is that least 10 metres away. This will trigger a Loud Noise Notification on the target Locker. Can be found in Treasure Chests located in the environment. Triggers Killer Instinct for 5 seconds after use. Magic Limited Items are depleted on use but kept on your person.They cannot be brought back to the Campfire after a Trial and are removed by The Entity upon exiting the Trial.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 7.2.0Limited Item It can only be found on the Nostromo Wreckage Map. Crouch over the body of a dead cosmonaut found in the environment and press the Interaction button to pick up the Keycard. Insert it into the terminal located by the Mass Hall to hack it. Perform the Hack Terminal interaction by pressing the keybinds for Left, Down, Up, Right. Hacking the terminal opens an airlock door to a secret room containing a Chest. Limited Items are consumed on use.They cannot be brought back to the Campfire after a Trial and are removed by The Entity upon exiting the Trial.

Limited Item Spawns in the environment when facing The Cenobite. Starts a Chain Hunt after 90 seconds of spawning into the environment Starts one immediately if picked up by The Cenobite. Reveals its Aura to all Survivors. Can be picked up and carried by Survivors. Resets the timer of the Lament Configuration and ends active Chain Hunts on other Survivors. Press the Use Item button to solve the Lament Configuration, causing it to respawn in a new location. Reveals your location to the The Cenobite while solving it through a special version of Killer Instinct and grants him the ability to teleport to you. Causes the Oblivious Status Effect when carried. Limited Items are consumed on use.They cannot be brought back to the Campfire after a Trial and are removed by The Entity upon exiting the Trial.

Limited Item A repaired pocket mirror pulled from the second White Glyph.Its surface is frosty. Grants 25,000 bonus Bloodpoints upon escaping the Trial with it. Limited Items are consumed on use.They cannot be brought back to the Campfire after a Trial and are removed by The Entity upon exiting the Trial.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 7.2.0Limited Item A flamethrower turret that Survivors can retrieve from Control Stations and placed in the environment. Tracks the presence of The Xenomorph within 41 metres of its location. This ability is briefly disabled whenever The Xenomorph exits the Tunnels. Grants immunity from Detection by The Xenomorph when it is inside the Tunnels while carrying the Turret. Survivors suffer from a -35 % Hindered Status Effect, and the Exhausted and Incapacitated Status Effects, while carrying the Turret. The Auras of Survivors carrying a Turret are revealed to all other Survivors. Shoots flames at a Crawler Mode The Xenomorph when within 10 metres and established Line of Sight. This slows The Xenomorph and knocks it out of Crawler Mode after filling the Power gauge. Overheats after doing so or when firing consecutively for 4 seconds. Overheated Turrets can be repaired and reactivated by Survivors. Multiple Turrets firing simultaneously do not stack their damage output. Dropping a Turret on the ground instead of deploying it destroys it after 30 seconds, unless at least one Survivor remains within 6 metres of where it was dropped. Can be destroyed by an attack from The Xenomorph. Limited Items are consumed on use.They cannot be brought back to the Campfire after a Trial and are removed by The Entity upon exiting the Trial.

This description is based on the changes announced for or featured in the upcoming Patch 7.5.0Limited Item The Cursed Tape can be retrieved from a TV located in the environment and must be reinserted into a specific one: Inserting the Cursed Tape reduces Condemned by -3 Stacks. This spreads The Onryō's message and temporarily turns the TV off. The specific TV is highlighted in yellow. Limited Items are consumed on use.They cannot be brought back to the Campfire after a Trial and are removed by The Entity upon exiting the Trial.

Limited Item A vaccine that helps reverse the effects of a T-Virus infection. Press the Use Item button to cure yourself or another Survivor from the T-Virus Infection. Can be found in Supply Cases located in the environment. The Vaccine has 1 Use. Limited Items are consumed on use.They cannot be brought back to the Campfire after a Trial and are removed by The Entity upon exiting the Trial.
